lines: What I recall from far away, in the moonlit sand,
is how we cowered in fear
Your hand was never full, never satisfied
Opening its mouth wide, it makes a meal of prayers
"Before the sun sets, if I could offer up
then neither the sand that carries eternity nor the shards of the moon
Opening its mouth wide, it devours prayers whole
Did they already hold the lamplight
"I want to tell you about the dream I had today
You were there, and I was there
Still full, still satisfied, under the red sky
we gazed at it, like people do"
